title: A Novel Quinoline Inhibitor of the Canonical NF-kappaB Transcription Factor Pathway.
authors: Ntavaroukas, Panagiotis; Michail, Konstantinos; Tsiakalidou, Rafaela; Stampouloglou, Eleni; Tsiggene, Katerina; Komiotis, Dimitrios; Georgiou, Nikitas; Mavromoustakos, Thomas; Manta, Stella; Aje, Danielle; Michael, Panagiotis; Campbell, Barry J; Papoutsopoulou, Stamatia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究喹啉类抑制剂Q3通过分子对接和MD模拟抑制NF-kappaB与DNA互作，虽涉及TF-DNA体系但以药物抑制为主，方法简单且非核心建模。
abstract: The NF-kappaB family of transcription factors is a master regulator of cellular responses during inflammation, and its dysregulation has been linked to chronic inflammatory diseases, such as inflammatory bowel disease. It is therefore of vital importance to design and test new effective NF-kappaB inhibitors that have the potential to be utilized in clinical practice. In this study, we used a commercial transgenic HeLa cell line as an NF-kappaB activation reporter to test a novel quinoline molecule, Q3, as a potential inhibitor of the canonical NF-kappaB pathway. Q3 inhibited NF-kappaB-induced luciferase in concentrations as low as 5 muM and did not interfere with cell survival or induced cell death. A real-time PCR analysis revealed that Q3 could inhibit the TNF-induced transcription of the luciferase gene, as well as the TNF gene, a known downstream target gene. Immunocytochemistry studies revealed that Q3 moderately interferes with TNF-induced NF-kappaB nuclear translocation. Moreover, docking and molecular dynamics analyses confirmed that Q3 could potentially modulate transcriptional activity by inhibiting the interaction of NF-kappaB and DNA. Therefore, Q3 could be potentially developed for further in vivo studies as an NF-kappaB inhibitor.
abstract_zh: NF-kappaB转录因子家族是炎症过程中细胞反应的主要调节因子，其失调与慢性炎症性疾病（如炎症性肠病）相关。因此，设计和测试新型有效的NF-kappaB抑制剂，并使其有望应用于临床实践，至关重要。在本研究中，我们使用商业化的转基因HeLa细胞系作为NF-kappaB激活报告系统，测试了一种新型喹啉分子Q3，作为经典NF-kappaB通路的潜在抑制剂。Q3在低至5 μM的浓度下抑制NF-kappaB诱导的荧光素酶活性，且不影响细胞存活或诱导细胞死亡。实时PCR分析显示，Q3能抑制TNF诱导的荧光素酶基因转录，以及已知下游靶基因TNF基因的转录。免疫细胞化学研究表明，Q3适度干扰TNF诱导的NF-kappaB核转位。此外，对接和分子动力学分析证实，Q3可能通过抑制NF-kappaB与DNA的相互作用来调节转录活性。因此，Q3有望作为NF-kappaB抑制剂进一步开发用于体内研究。
